column1: # The COMPILED VERIFIER and the INDEPENDENT POSIX/Git WITNESS are
# compared fact by fact. The verifier RE-DERIVES its counts from the
# measured input tables; the independent witness RECOMPUTES from the
# Git object store. They share NO detection algorithm.
# A fact the verifier does not MEASURE is NOT_MEASURED_BY_VERIFIER,
# which is NOT a disagreement. A fact both measure must AGREE.
